cues: After fertilization the whole flower is rebuilt.
The ovule becomes the seed, the ovary the fruit, the ovary wall the pericarp.
The integuments harden into the seed coat.
The zygote becomes the embryo, the primary endosperm nucleus the endosperm.
The nucellus is usually used up, and the synergids and antipodals die.
text: After fertilization the whole flower is rebuilt. The ovule becomes the seed, the ovary the fruit, the ovary wall the pericarp. The integuments harden into the seed coat. The zygote becomes the embryo, the primary endosperm nucleus the endosperm. The nucellus is usually used up, and the synergids and antipodals die.
